item.description: Wile E. Coyote is getting his comeback after all Coyote vs. Acme is actually expanding for its second weekend, moving into 3,727 North American theaters compared with 3,575 during its opening weekend. And considering what happened behind the scenes, that's pretty wild. The movie opened at No. 2 domestically with $15.9 million, giving distributor Ketchup Entertainment its biggest opening ever. Even crazier? This is the same movie Warner Bros. once planned to shelve completely. Instead of disappearing into a vault, Coyote vs. Acme is now getting a real theatrical run - and audiences have the chance to decide what happens next. So if you've been waiting years to see Wile E. Coyote finally get his moment on the big screen... this is your chance.
